arabic text:
Rukh Kerkey Baqayya Ka, Sheh Kehtey Rahe Bhai.
Betay Ki Tere Mayyat, Puri Nahi Mill Payi.
Dhoonda Tho Bohot Meiney Par Mill Nahi Paya Hai.
Maqtal Me Issey Meiney, Chun-Chun Ke Uthayya Hai.
english translation text:
Pausing again and again, the Master said, "Brother..."
I could not recover your son's body in its entirety.
I searched for him so much, but I could not find every piece.
From the battlefield, I gathered him piece by piece.

arabic text:
Tukdon me Badan Hoker, Maidan Me Pehla Hai.
Tareekh Me Dunya Ki, Ye Pehla Janazza Hai.
Naa Pooch Ye Ghatdi Mein Kiss Terha Samayya Hai.
Maqtal Me Issey Meiney, Chun-Chun Ke Uthayya.
english translation text:
His body was torn into fragments and scattered across the field.
In all of history, this is the first funeral of its kind.
Do not ask how I carried him within this bundle.
From the battlefield, I gathered him piece by piece.

arabic text:
Haathon Ko Kabhi Ser Ko, Seenay Ko Uthata Tha.
Aur Baaqi Janazzay Ko, Mein Dhoondta Jaata Tha.
Isnay Mujhey Ghurbat Ka Ehsaas Dilaya Hai.
Maqtal Me Issey Meiney, Chun-Chun Ke Uthayya Hai.
english translation text:
At times I would lift a hand, at times a head,
At times a piece of his chest, while searching for the rest of the body.
He made me truly feel the pain of loneliness.
From the battlefield, I gathered him piece by piece.

arabic text:
Qasim main teri maa ko, kis tarhan say batlaon.
Yehee hay tera beta, kaisay usay samjhaon.
Ye soch kay ankhon say khoon Sheh nay bahaya.
Maqtal Me Issey Meiney, Chun-Chun Ke Uthayya Hai.
english translation text:
Qasim, how shall I explain this to your mother?
How shall I convince her that this is her son?
Thinking of this, the King of Martyrs wept tears of blood.
From the battlefield, I gathered him piece by piece.

arabic text:
Farwa teri doulat par ayi hai khiza
ban main.
khuch tukray abhi shayad baki hain wahin run main.
kis dil se Shahe deen nay ye maa ko bataya hay.
maqtal main isay main nay chun chun kay uthaya hai.
english translation text:
Farwa, the autumn of sorrow has come upon
your greatest treasure. Perhaps some fragments still remain
upon the battlefield. With what heart did the
King of Faith explain this to the mother?
From the battlefield, I gathered him piece by piece.

arabic text:
Poocha jo ye Zainab nay, ghatri main hay kya bhai.
Sarwar nay kaha roker, Qasim ki hay lash aye.
Iss lash ka zalim nay wo hall banaya hai.
Maqtal Me Issey Meiney, Chun-Chun Ke Uthayya Hai.
english translation text:
When Zainab asked, "Brother, what is in this bundle?"
The Master replied through tears, "It is the body of Qasim."
The tyrant left this body in such a state.
From the battlefield, I gathered him piece by piece.

arabic text: Maqtal Me Issey Meiney, Chun-Chun Ke Uthayya Hai
english translation text: From the battlefield, I gathered him piece by piece.
